answer: Picture new agents arriving at a wharf where each must be vouched for by an established peer who locks a refundable bond. Spin up a thousand sybils and the sponsor's stake freezes like tundra; if any one misbehaves, the entire bond is slashed. Honest attestations drift in cheap as a zephyr, but minting fake identities costs real, forfeitable capital per fake, so an attacker pays linearly and gains no voting weight.
